name: JadirGabriel Editorial AI
author: jadirgabriel

sections.description:
JadirGabriel Editorial AI helps WordPress publishers reduce repetitive editorial work without requiring complicated technical configuration.

With the free plugin you can:

  • add RSS sources that you are authorized to monitor;
  • manually fetch new content ideas;
  • organize incoming items in a simple queue;
  • prepare drafts with Google Gemini or OpenAI;
  • review every draft before publishing;
  • reduce duplicate imports;
  • inspect local activity logs.

The free version does not publish automatically. You choose an item, generate a draft, review it, and decide when to publish it.

External services

JadirGabriel Editorial AI connects to external services only when you explicitly configure or use them.

  1. RSS sources you add: the plugin sends an HTTP request to each RSS URL you configure in order to retrieve feed content.
  2. Google Gemini: when Gemini is selected, the title and available source content for the selected item are sent to Google’s Gemini API to generate the draft. Terms: https://ai.google.dev/terms — Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  3. OpenAI: when OpenAI is selected, the title and available source content for the selected item are sent to the OpenAI API to generate the draft. Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/ — Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

You must provide your own API key for the AI provider you choose. API usage limits and charges are determined by that provider.

JadirGabriel Editorial AI does not send telemetry to the plugin developer and does not require an account or paid license to use the free version.

Editorial responsibility

Only monitor sources you are authorized to use and respect applicable copyright and editorial rules. JadirGabriel Editorial AI is an editorial assistance tool. Review and publication decisions remain under the user’s control.

Free and Pro editions

Editor IA Pro is a separate commercial product with additional automation and advanced workflow features. Premium code is not included in this free plugin. Links shown inside the Free plugin only provide information about the separate Pro product.

Privacy

JadirGabriel Editorial AI does not send telemetry to the developer. When you use an AI provider, the data required for draft generation is sent directly from your WordPress site to the selected provider, as described in the External services section.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the jadirgabriel-editorial-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate JadirGabriel Editorial AI.
  3. Open JadirGabriel Editorial AI > Easy Mode.
  4. Choose Gemini or OpenAI and enter your own API key.
  5. Add one or more RSS sources under Sites I follow.
  6. Click Fetch news now.
  7. Open Incoming news and choose an item to prepare with AI.
sections.faq:
Do I need programming knowledge?

No. The main setup is designed to be completed through Easy Mode and the built-in tutorial.

Does the free plugin publish automatically?

No. The free version creates WordPress drafts for you to review.

Does the free version expire?

No. JadirGabriel Editorial AI Free does not require a paid license and does not expire.

Do I need an AI API key?

Yes, if you want to generate AI-assisted drafts. You can use your own Google Gemini or OpenAI API key.

What happens if an RSS feed contains malformed XML?

JadirGabriel Editorial AI first uses the standard WordPress feed reader and includes a tolerant fallback for some malformed XML feeds.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. Editor IA Pro is a separate product for workflows that require more automation and advanced controls.

  • Renames the plugin to JadirGabriel Editorial AI with the distinct slug and text domain jadirgabriel-editorial-ai.
  • Moves admin CSS and JavaScript to properly enqueued asset files.
  • Keeps existing Free settings and data keys unchanged for compatibility with migration to Editor IA Pro.

1.0.33

  • Torna traduzível a mensagem de fallback de erros HTTP das APIs OpenAI e Gemini, sem alterar o tratamento das respostas.

1.0.31

  • Corrige tradução redundante na mensagem de lista vazia dos Logs.

1.0.30

  • Prepara para tradução o diagnóstico de suporte e os cartões de recursos Free/Pro, sem alterar o comportamento do plugin.

  • Completa a preparação para tradução dos textos restantes na tela de fontes RSS, sem alterar o comportamento do plugin.

  • Evita dupla codificação das mensagens exibidas após redirecionamentos administrativos.
  • Mantém sanitização e escape na saída, sem alterar RSS, IA, fila ou criação de rascunhos.

1.0.21

  • Completa a preparação para tradução das telas de tutorial, fila e logs, sem alterar o comportamento do plugin.
  • Mantém inalterados os fluxos de RSS, IA e criação de rascunhos.

1.0.20

  • Remove a dependência direta da extensão PHP mbstring ao limitar a meta description, usando uma função nativa do WordPress.
  • Mantém inalterados os fluxos de RSS, IA, fila e criação de rascunhos.

1.0.19

  • Completa a preparação para tradução dos textos exibidos no Modo Fácil, sem alterar o fluxo de RSS, IA, fila ou criação de rascunhos.

1.0.18

  • Limita a 2 MB a resposta do modo tolerante de RSS, evitando downloads anormalmente grandes sem alterar o fluxo normal de leitura.

1.0.17

  • Reforça o tratamento das respostas HTTP da OpenAI e do Gemini quando a API retorna sucesso com corpo vazio ou JSON inválido.

1.0.16

  • Padroniza o tratamento de entradas administrativas com wp_unslash() antes da sanitização.
  • Mantém intactos os fluxos de RSS, IA, fila e criação de rascunhos.
